# Assessment 1

```{r}
# Yixin Ling
# yl2212@cam.ac.uk
# Assessment 1

# Setup 

# Load packages and data in this section

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
street_crime <- read.csv("https://clanfear.github.io/ioc_iqa/_data/street_crime.csv")

# 1
# 1.1
street_crime |> count(crime_type)         
street_crime |> count(sex)    
mean(street_crime$age)
median(street_crime$sentence)

# 1.2
street_crime |> count(crime_type, sort = TRUE)

# 1.3
tabyl(street_crime, crime_type, sex)

# 1.4
model1 <- lm(sentence ~ crime_type + sex + age, data = street_crime)
summary(model1)

# 2
# 2.1
street_crime |>group_by(crime_type) |>summarise(mean_sentence = mean(sentence))

# 2.2

ggplot(street_crime, aes(x = sentence)) +geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, colour = "black", fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of sentence length",x = "Sentence (months)",y = "Number of individuals")

# 2.3
crime_sex_table <- table(street_crime$crime_type,street_crime$sex)
chisq.test(crime_sex_table)

# 2.4
summary(model1)

# 3
# 3.1
ggplot(street_crime, aes(x = age, y = sentence)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = "Age and sentence length",
    x = "Age at sentencing (years)",
    y = "Sentence (months)"
  )

# 3.2
predict(model1, newdata=data.frame(crime_type = factor("Assault"),sex = factor("Male"),age = 20))

# 3.3
summary(lm(sentence ~ sex,data = street_crime))

```
